S38.01.needs: a Free account or a paid account (none special)
S38.01.note: The sidebar container was not opened; 'Study' is the nav item label in app-nav-items.ts (the navStudy translation key was not found in any translation file). The same Study row also appears in the chat composer '+' menu (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerPlusMenu.tsx, label 'Study'), but the exact text of that '+' button was not found. Session creation itself was not checked.
steps: Sign in and click Study in the sidebar.
On the Study page, type a subject in the field 'What are you studying?' (for example: eigenvalues).
Leave How set to 'Learn it' and click 'Start studying'.
Look at whether a new chat opens at /chat/<id> with the study tutoring started, and compare with Expected.

S38.02.note: The field is a single text input for the topic; the Study page has no separate 'goal' field, so the goal is entered as the topic.
steps: Sign in and click Study in the sidebar.
Click the field 'What are you studying?' and type a learning goal or topic (for example: photosynthesis).
Check that 'Start studying' stays disabled while the field is empty and becomes enabled once text is typed.
Compare the form with Expected: the user has stated the topic before the session starts.
S38.02.where: Sidebar > Study > What are you studying?

S38.03.needs: none (a project is needed to see the 'Course material' drop-down)
S38.03.note: Subject is entered as free text in 'What are you studying?'; there is no list of subjects. 'Course material' picks a project, not a subject, and only appears when projects exist.
steps: Sign in and click Study in the sidebar.
Click the field 'What are you studying?' and type the subject (for example: German dative case).
Optionally open the 'Course material' drop-down (shown only when the account has projects) and choose 'From project: <name>' or 'None'.
Compare with Expected: the user has picked the subject to study and it appears in the session title after starting.
S38.03.where: Sidebar > Study > What are you studying?

S38.04.note: The level choice is sent to the server as part of the session, and its effect on the tutor is inside the server instruction (apps/web/features/study/lib/study-session.ts), so the adaptation is only visible in the chat answers, not on the Study page.
steps: Sign in and click Study in the sidebar.
Open the drop-down 'Where you are with it' and choose 'Some background' (other choices: 'New to it', 'Know it well').
Type a topic, leave How as 'Learn it', and click 'Start studying'.
In the new chat, ask a basic question and compare the tutor's explanation depth with Expected: it should adapt to the chosen level.
S38.04.where: Sidebar > Study > Where you are with it
